events.headline: Kenneth Walker III (groin) limited in his first practice since Week 9; Reid "not anticipating a ton of work" Thursday at Buffalo
events.detail: Walker has not played since Nov. 8 and returned to practice on a limited basis Tuesday ahead of Thursday's Thanksgiving game at Buffalo. Andy Reid said "We'll see how he does" and that he was not anticipating a ton of work for him, per Yahoo's live NFL feed. Patrick Mahomes (knee/right elbow) and TE Noah Gray (rib) were listed as full participants on the same report, per Yahoo/Arrowhead Pride.
events.so_what: Limited plus a coach lowering expectations is a forecast, not a clearance, and a Thursday game leaves only Wednesday's report to settle it. If he is active, treat him as a FLEX with a capped workload rather than a locked RB2, and have a Sunday-or-later fallback ready because a Thursday inactive leaves no time to pivot. Mahomes practicing fully keeps him a normal start.

source.label: Yahoo Sports/Arrowhead Pride: Chiefs-Bills Week 12 Tuesday injury report (Nov. 24)

events.headline: J.K. Dobbins suspended one game by the Broncos for conduct detrimental; Jonah Coleman in line to start at Pittsburgh
events.detail: Sean Payton announced a one-game team suspension for "conduct detrimental to the team" and did not elaborate, per Yahoo's live NFL feed. Dobbins has 324 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 99 carries. Yahoo expects rookie Jonah Coleman (302 rushing yards in six games) to start. Yahoo's article places the suspension on the Week 12 game at Pittsburgh, while Payton's post refers to "Sunday's game", so the exact game is reported inconsistently.
events.so_what: Dobbins is a zero for Week 12: bench him, and do not drop him for a one-game team suspension. Coleman becomes a volume FLEX for the week with the early-down and goal-line work in his hands, and the move is worth watching beyond one game if Payton's staff likes what it sees.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Micah Parsons set to return, 49ers waive Brandon Aiyuk (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Brandon Aiyuk released by the 49ers and clears waivers; Washington named among expected suitors
events.detail: San Francisco waived Aiyuk on Monday and he has cleared waivers, so he is free to sign anywhere, per Adam Schefter via Yahoo's live NFL feed. Schefter reports he wants to sign soon and is expected to draw interest, including from Washington. He has not played since tearing his ACL and MCL in October 2024.
events.so_what: He is a deep bench stash at most until he signs, practices and shows a role: two years off the field means no team will hand him starter snaps on arrival. If Washington is the landing spot, it is a target-hungry offense with Terry McLaurin hurt, which is the only scenario that makes him a real add.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, 49ers waive Brandon Aiyuk (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Josh Jacobs (fractured ring finger, post-surgery) listed questionable for Wednesday's game at the Rams
events.detail: Jacobs, who fractured his right ring finger in Week 9 and had surgery, carries a questionable designation for Wednesday's game in Los Angeles, per Yahoo's live NFL feed, which also links a report that he could still land on injured reserve. Kaleb Johnson has 24 carries over the last two games with Jacobs out, per RotoWire (Nov. 23).
events.so_what: Questionable on a Wednesday game means the decision lands before most lineups are even being thought about, so check the inactive list about 90 minutes before kickoff. If Jacobs sits, Kaleb Johnson is a volume start again; if Jacobs plays with a protected hand, treat him as a FLEX until he shows his full carry share.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Jacobs questionable vs. Rams (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Sam Darnold (quad) in line to start Sunday vs. the 49ers after missing two games; Macdonald wants to see Wednesday first
events.detail: Seattle plans to start Darnold against San Francisco, per Yahoo's live NFL feed, but Mike Macdonald said "before we make any declarations for Sam, we'll get through Wednesday." Darnold has missed two games with the quad injury suffered in Week 8.
events.so_what: A planned start is still a forecast until he practices. If he plays, Seahawks pass catchers get their starting quarterback back, which is a clear upgrade over the fill-in. Darnold himself offers no rushing floor, so he is a matchup streamer at best.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Darnold expected to start (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Antonio Williams posts 9-122 on 11 targets vs. Cincinnati, his fourth productive game in five since Terry McLaurin's injury
events.detail: Williams caught 9 of 11 targets for 122 yards in the Monday night win over the Bengals, including a 42-yard catch-and-run that set up the winning field goal, per FantasyPros. He has 50-plus yards or a touchdown in four of five games since McLaurin was hurt, per Yahoo's waiver column. Washington plays at Arizona in Week 12.
events.so_what: This is a real target role, not a one-game spike: 11 targets is a WR1 workload in this offense while McLaurin is out. He is a FLEX start at Arizona and a priority add. His value drops back to bench depth whenever McLaurin returns, so it is a rental, and Aiyuk landing in Washington would also cut into it.

source.label: FantasyPros: Waiver wire advice, players to add, stash and drop for Week 12 (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Dylan Sampson has out-snapped Quinshon Judkins three games running in a Browns backfield now split down the middle
events.detail: Sampson has 77, 69, 48 and 37 scrimmage yards in four games since returning from a knee injury and has out-snapped Judkins in three straight, a 50-50 split, per Yahoo's waiver column. He has at least three catches in all four games, per FantasyPros. Cleveland hosts Las Vegas in Week 12, with Deshaun Watson coming off three straight 300-yard passing games.
events.so_what: Judkins can no longer be treated as a locked RB2: the snaps are even, and Sampson owns the passing-down work, which keeps his floor steady even on days the carries split. Sampson is a FLEX add. Judkins drops to a FLEX who needs a touchdown to return value.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Caleb Douglas commands a 30.3% target share in Miami's second game without Malik Willis
events.detail: With Willis on IR, Douglas has 3-71 on 8 targets against Indianapolis and 2-30 on 10 targets with Kyle McCord at quarterback, per FantasyPros, which put his Week 11 target share at 30.3% despite a couple of drops. He has eight or more targets in each of the last three games, per Yahoo. Miami hosts the Jets in Week 12.
events.so_what: The targets are real and the quarterback is the cap: a first-time starter limits his yardage and touchdown ceiling. He is a volume FLEX in a pinch and a bench hold otherwise, with his value rising as soon as Willis returns.

source.label: FantasyPros: Waiver wire advice for Week 12 (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Ted Hurst III scores twice as his snap share climbs to 64%, the Buccaneers saying they plan to feature him more
events.detail: Hurst caught 5 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two touchdowns at Detroit on a 64% snap share, his highest since Week 3, and the coach said the team plans to feature him more, per Yahoo's waiver column. He ranked third among Tampa Bay receivers in snaps and routes behind Chris Godwin, per FantasyPros. RotoWire called both touchdowns late and semi-fluky, though Jalen McMillan (knee) being out opens red-zone work.
events.so_what: One two-touchdown game on seven targets is a boom week, not a role yet. He is a bench add with upside where you have the spot, and a FLEX only once his target count matches the snap share.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Chimere Dike leads Tennessee in targets for a third straight game with Wan'Dale Robinson out
events.detail: Over the last three games without Robinson, Dike has 13 catches for 156 yards and a touchdown on 16 targets, including 6-69 on a team-high 7 targets at Dallas while back in the slot after Carnell Tate returned, per FantasyPros. He has played 50-plus offensive snaps in three straight games, per RotoWire. Tennessee plays at Jacksonville in Week 12.
events.so_what: A steady slot role with modest volume: he is bench depth with a FLEX floor in a bye-week pinch, not a weekly starter, since a road game at Jacksonville is no help.

source.label: FantasyPros: Waiver wire advice for Week 12 (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Saquon Barkley (left shoulder) limited on Monday's estimate but says he expects to play Thanksgiving at Dallas
events.detail: Barkley left Sunday's win over Pittsburgh in the fourth quarter with a left arm or shoulder injury and did not return. The Eagles' Monday report was an estimate with no practice, and listed him limited with neck and illness designations, per the Philadelphia Inquirer. Barkley said the shoulder should not keep him out Thursday but added "I don't think I'm ever going to get to 100% again the rest of the season," per Bleacher Report. Will Shipley returned in Week 11 from a partial plantar fascia tear that cost him four games, per FantasyPros.
events.so_what: Expected to play is a forecast; Wednesday's report is the last read before a Thursday lock. If he is active, start him, because his touch share is what drives his value and nothing suggests the Eagles plan to cut it. Shipley is the handcuff to hold, and he becomes a volume start only if Barkley is ruled out.

source.label: Bleacher Report: Saquon Barkley updates status for Eagles-Cowboys Thanksgiving game (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) reaggravated in Week 11; Liam Coen says the recheck "wasn't too bad" but Week 12 status is unresolved
events.detail: Tuten limped off late in the loss to the Giants after being stepped on twice, on top of ongoing foot and ankle trouble, and played only 43% of the snaps with 13 touches for 53 yards, per Yahoo's waiver column. Coen said the recheck was not too bad and that Tuten would be limited in practice this week, with a decision on Sunday against Tennessee coming later in the week, per Yahoo Sports. Chris Rodriguez Jr. would lead the backfield if Tuten sits; he has not topped 11 carries in a game this season, per FantasyPros.
events.so_what: This is a month-long lower-body problem that keeps recurring, so even if Tuten plays, his snap share is the risk rather than his talent. Rodriguez is the add of the week at running back: a likely starter if Tuten sits, with Jacksonville a big home favorite, and a short-yardage piece if he does not. Hold Tuten through Wednesday's report.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Bhayshul Tuten injury update casts doubt on Jaguars RB's Week 12 status (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Justin Herbert in the concussion protocol after the loss to the Jets; DJ Uiagalelei is the only other QB on the roster
events.detail: Herbert went 15-of-21 for 131 yards and two touchdowns and ran for a third in the 27-24 loss to the Jets, then entered the concussion protocol; the team said he would be evaluated this week and gave no timeline, per UPI. DJ Uiagalelei is the only other quarterback on the active roster, with Jake Browning on the practice squad. The 1-9 Chargers host New England in Week 12. Keaton Mitchell also left the game with knee and back injuries, which puts Kimani Vidal in line for more work, per RotoWire (Nov. 23).
events.so_what: Protocol has no fixed timeline, so plan Week 12 without Herbert and pick up a streamer now rather than on Sunday morning. Herbert's three-touchdown line is exactly the 4-point-pass-TD plus rushing profile that is hard to replace, which is why waiting on him past Week 12 is reasonable where you have the bench room. Chargers pass catchers drop to FLEX risk with Uiagalelei, and Vidal is a desperation back only.

source.label: UPI: Herbert, McKivitz, Darrisaw among players injured in NFL's Week 11 (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Daniel Jones clears waivers after his Colts release; Anthony Richardson takes over as Indianapolis starter
events.detail: Indianapolis released Jones on Friday and he cleared waivers Monday afternoon, making him a free agent the Colts will keep paying, per NBC Sports/PFT. Anthony Richardson is expected to start, with Riley Leonard as his backup, per RotoWire's waiver column. Reports name Arizona as a possible landing spot for Jones; New England and Cleveland were reported as not interested.
events.so_what: Richardson is the most interesting quarterback on most wires because of the konami rushing premium: his legs give him a floor that pocket streamers lack, though his accuracy keeps it volatile. Jones is a drop until he signs somewhere with a path to starts. Colts pass catchers, Tyler Warren first, take on more variance with Richardson throwing.

source.label: NBC Sports/PFT: Daniel Jones clears waivers, becomes free agent (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Puka Nacua out for the season after knee surgery; Terrance Ferguson also done with ankle surgery, leaving Tyler Higbee as the lead tight end
events.detail: The Rams ruled Nacua out for the rest of 2026 after surgery on the knee he hurt Nov. 8 against Washington, per SI's Rams coverage. On Nov. 23 Sean McVay said Ferguson will stay on injured reserve for the season because his ankle needs surgery; rehab of an earlier hamstring injury slowed the ankle's recovery. Higbee, Colby Parkinson, Davis Allen and rookie Max Klare are the remaining tight ends. Davante Adams (hamstring) is expected back no earlier than Week 13, per FantasyPros, and Konata Mumpfield led Rams receivers with a 64% snap share before the Week 11 bye.
events.so_what: Nacua is a drop now that the IR stash has no return date, unless your IR slot has nothing better to hold. Higbee is a streaming tight end with the clearest path to targets in this offense. Mumpfield is a bench piece until Adams returns, and Adams himself becomes the first read whenever he is activated.

source.label: SI Ram Digest: Rams lose Terrance Ferguson for season as injury situation continues to spiral (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Tommy DeVito named Patriots starter for Week 12 at the Chargers with Drake Maye (right ankle) out indefinitely
events.detail: Maye was hurt on the first drive of the Week 10 loss to Detroit in Munich; the Patriots fear a fractured right ankle and Mike Vrabel said he likely will not be available coming out of the bye, per the Boston Globe (Nov. 16). Adam Schefter called him out indefinitely, if not for the season. DeVito went 12-of-24 for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception in relief and is the Week 12 starter, per Yahoo's live NFL feed (Nov. 24). A.J. Brown (hamstring) is also out, which leaves Demario Douglas as the most-targeted healthy receiver, per CBS Sports.
events.so_what: Maye goes to IR where your slot allows, or the wire if it does not; there is no return date to plan around. DeVito is not a streamer and every Patriots pass catcher takes a downgrade. Douglas is a target-volume FLEX only in a pinch.

source.label: Boston Globe: Drake Maye injury update (Nov. 16)

events.headline: Derrick Henry cleared the concussion protocol after Sunday's evaluation; Jacoby Brissett starts again with Lamar Jackson on IR
events.detail: Henry was evaluated for a concussion in the fourth quarter of the 35-33 loss at Carolina after 111 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 17 touches, per UPI, and has since cleared the protocol, per Yahoo's waiver column (Nov. 24). Justice Hill had 6 carries for 69 yards and a touchdown plus 4 catches in the same game. Brissett, acquired in a deadline trade with Arizona, has thrown 49 and 37 passes in his two Baltimore starts, per FantasyPros. Lamar Jackson had surgery on his right thumb and Jesse Minter said the injury typically needs six to 10 weeks to heal, per AP via NY1 (Nov. 13).
events.so_what: Henry is a normal start at Houston: lock him back into the lineup. Hill's role is tied to Brissett's pass volume, not to Henry missing time, so he is a FLEX only in deeper formats and his Week 11 line came on just 10 touches. Jackson stays on IR, and his late-season return is not something to plan a playoff lineup around.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire, Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Dylan Sampson among top pickups (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Brock Bowers (ankle, quad) missed Week 11 at Denver; Fernando Mendoza threw three touchdowns without him
events.detail: Bowers was out against the Broncos with ankle and quad injuries that have lingered since he left the Seattle game, per ESPN's Week 11 takeaways. Mendoza threw for 267 yards and three touchdowns with 22 rushing yards in the game, and Jack Bech caught 8 of 9 targets for 88 yards and a score, per Yahoo's waiver column. Las Vegas plays at Cleveland in Week 12 and then has its bye.
events.so_what: Bowers is a hold, not a drop: the ankle has no structural damage reported, but with a Week 13 bye coming the team has a reason to sit him one more week, so have a tight end streamer ready. Mendoza's line was a real ceiling game, three 4-point passing scores plus some rushing, and he is a legitimate streamer at Cleveland. Bech is a one-game spike tied to Bowers' absence.

source.label: ESPN: NFL Week 11 big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Roschon Johnson (ankle) hurt in the first quarter of the win over New Orleans; estimated DNP ahead of Thursday at Detroit
events.detail: Johnson had 103 rushing yards in the 21-13 win over the Saints despite getting hurt in the first quarter, and Ben Johnson said the ankle would be evaluated this week, per UPI. The Bears' Monday estimate listed him as not practicing ahead of Thursday's Thanksgiving game at Detroit, per Pride of Detroit via Yahoo.
events.so_what: An estimated DNP three days before a Thursday game is a bad sign, so plan to start someone else and treat a surprise activation as a bonus. His 103-yard game shows the role is worth holding for after the short week.

source.label: UPI: Herbert, McKivitz, Darrisaw among players injured in NFL's Week 11 (Nov. 23)

events.headline: Juwan Johnson (hamstring) left Sunday's loss at Chicago and did not return; Noah Fant next up for New Orleans
events.detail: Johnson exited the loss to the Bears with a hamstring injury, per RotoWire's Week 12 waiver column. Devaughn Vele caught all seven of his targets for 76 yards in the same game, and Fant had 2 catches for 19 yards on 5 targets, per CBS Sports.
events.so_what: Hamstrings that end a player's day usually cost at least a week, so bench Johnson until he practices. Fant is a deep tight end streamer only. Vele's game came largely after Johnson's exit and makes him a bench piece rather than a FLEX.

source.label: RotoWire: Top fantasy football waiver wire pickups for Week 12 (Nov. 23)
